watcher.syn: As a serial killer stalks the city, Julia — a young actress who just moved to town with her husband — notices a mysterious stranger watching her from across the street.

western-union.syn: When Edward Creighton leads the construction of the Western Union to unite East with West, he hires a Western reformed outlaw and a tenderfoot Eastern surveyor.  Preserved by the Academy Film Archive in partnership with Twentieth Century Fox Film Corporation i

whip-it.syn: In Bodeen, Texas, an indie-rock loving misfit finds a way of dealing with her small-town misery after she discovers a roller derby league in nearby Austin.

win-it-all.syn: A gambling addict faces a conflict when entrusted with keeping a bunch of money that isn't his.

x-men-days-of-future-past.syn: The ultimate X-Men ensemble fights a war for the survival of the species across two time periods as they join forces with their younger selves in an epic battle that must change the past – to save our future.

yes-giorgio.syn: A famous opera singer, Giorgio Fini, loses his voice during an American tour. He goes to a female throat specialist, Pamela Taylor, whom he falls in love with.
